item.title: Associate professor: Selection process for the recruitment of one Associate Professor – DISCIPLINARY SCIENTIFIC GROUP: 08/CEAR-04 GEOMATICS, DISCIPLINARY SCIENTIFIC SECTOR: CEAR-04/A GEOMATICS (Telemat. G.FORTUNATO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-20 12:00
Institution: Telemat. G.FORTUNATO, Benevento
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-04 Geomatica

The candidate must have e-learning teaching experience at Italian and/or foreign online universities. Weight will be given to the design and management of structured e-learning courses (transmissive and interactive teaching, video lectures, digital materials, e-tivities, LMS, monitoring of learning outcomes, tutoring) and to specific training in this field. Videoconference teaching alone is not sufficient. A proven aptitude for research is required (high-quality scientific output, national and international research groups, research periods abroad), together with consolidated expertise in GNSS: precise positioning, multi-sensor integration, mobile mapping and high-precision vehicle…
